zh.caption: 圖 1｜一次網頁操作的概念流程
zh.description: 箭頭表示本例的概念處理順序；實作架構與通訊需另行確認。

items.title: 1. 使用者操作
items.body: 選擇牛肉麵，按下送出

items.title: 2. Browser（瀏覽器）
items.body: 收集品項、數量、桌號等資料

items.title: 3. HTTP／其他通訊機制
items.body: 把資料送往處理訂單的系統

items.title: 4. Server（伺服器）
items.body: 確認商品、價格、庫存與訂購權限

items.title: 5. 資料儲存與業務處理
items.body: 建立訂單、儲存結果

items.title: 6. 回傳結果
items.body: 畫面顯示訂單成立，或提示失敗原因

zh.caption: 圖 2｜分別核對三層結果
zh.description: 三列是不同的判讀責任，通過其中一層不保證其餘層成立。

items.title: 第一層：通訊結果
items.body: 請求有沒有成功送達並獲得預期回應？HTTP 狀態是什麼？

items.title: 第二層：業務結果
items.body: 內容是否符合規則？例如資料齊全、庫存足夠、符合受理條件。

items.title: 第三層：使用者任務完成
items.body: 訂單真的成立、報告能正確下載，或使用者確實取得需要的結果了嗎？

zh.caption: 圖 3｜自訂 HTTP API 與 Streamlit 的概念對照
zh.description: 兩條獨立路徑均為概念示意；實際請求、WebSocket 訊息與其他連線，需由文件、原始碼或封包確認。validate() 是程序內呼叫，不是此圖宣稱存在的 HTTP 端點。

items.title: 傳統自訂 HTTP API 的概念
items.body: Browser → HTTP API → Backend → Response

items.title: Streamlit 的概念
items.body: Browser → Streamlit 框架通訊 → Python 程序 → validate()

en.caption: Figure 1 | Conceptual flow of a web action
en.description: Arrows show the conceptual processing order in this example; verify the actual architecture and communication separately.

items.title: 1. User action
items.body: Choose beef noodles and press submit

items.title: 2. Browser
items.body: Collect item, quantity, table number and other data

items.title: 3. HTTP / other communication
items.body: Send data to the order-processing system

items.title: 4. Server
items.body: Check products, prices, inventory and permission to order

items.title: 5. Storage and business processing
items.body: Create the order and save the result

items.title: 6. Return the result
items.body: Show order acceptance or explain the failure

en.caption: Figure 2 | Check three outcome levels separately
en.description: These rows are separate checks; passing one does not guarantee the others.

items.title: Level 1: Communication result
items.body: Did the request arrive and receive the expected response? What was its HTTP status?

items.title: Level 2: Business result
items.body: Does the content meet the rules: complete data, enough stock and acceptance conditions?

items.title: Level 3: User task completion
items.body: Was the order accepted, can the correct report be downloaded, or did the user obtain the required outcome?

en.caption: Figure 3 | Custom HTTP API and Streamlit concepts
en.description: The independent paths are conceptual. Verify actual requests, WebSocket messages and connections from documentation, source or traffic. validate() is an in-process call, not an HTTP endpoint established by this figure.

items.title: Custom HTTP API concept
items.body: Browser → HTTP API → Backend → Response

items.title: Streamlit concept
items.body: Browser → Streamlit framework communication → Python process → validate()
